name: computer
description: Control Mac apps through an open accessibility adapter, with a confirmation policy for risky actions. Dry-run by default.

tools.name: list_apps
tools.description: List apps available to the computer adapter.

tools.name: get_app_state
tools.description: Get the current state for an app, without touching it.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element or coordinate in an app. Requires confirmation for risky targets.

tools.name: type_text
tools.description: Type text into an app. Sensitive data transmission requires pre-approval or confirmation.
